call_points.text: FY27 volume growth expected at around 18%, same as guided at the start of FY26
Targets 100 bps year-on-year margin improvement and says it is confident of achieving it
New wire capacity at Silvassa expected this quarter; cable capacity at Waghodia during the year
Data centre is still at announcement stage; orders are few and its share of revenue is very small
Industry Wires & Cables growth assessed at 10-12% for the quarter, below the company's own pace
Margin gain attributed to scale and cost absorption, with no inventory gain or loss in the quarter
Metal prices up about 40% YoY, expected to reflect as about 25% in product pricing
Middle East disruption offset by other export markets; shipments normalised in May and June but supply-chain issues remain
US is a large opportunity but tariff clarity is pending; only a few approvals so far
FMEG targets about 20% annual growth and sustainable yearly breakeven this year, profitability in 2-3 years
Wires & cables segment profit margin rose 143 bps for the year

guidance.statement: Wires & Cables margin guidance maintained at 10.5% by FY28
Volume growth of around 18% year-on-year expected in FY27
Capex of ₹1,200 Cr over FY26-FY28, with ₹600-650 Cr in FY27
FMEG growth of around 20% a year with sustainable yearly breakeven this year and profitability in 2-3 years

industry: Industrials > Capital Goods > Industrial Products > Cables - Electricals

operating_notes.text: Exports were 26% of FY26 revenue mix versus 25% in FY25; domestic 74%.
Wires & cables segment profit margin was 8.9% for FY26 versus 7.4% in FY25.
FMEG segment loss was ₹33.0 Cr in FY26 against ₹45.9 Cr in FY25.
Wires & Cables volumes grew 17% YoY in Q1FY27, with cables above 25% and wires about 12%.
Cable capacity utilisation was about 90% and wire utilisation 65-70%; net working capital was 50 days.
Retail touch points exceed 1.5 lakh, with 20,000-25,000 added last year; North and West contribute about 65% of domestic revenue.

timeline.summary: R R Kabel reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹9,722.4 Cr (+27.6% YoY) and PAT of ₹492.2 Cr (+58.0%), with inventories rising to ₹1,770.5 Cr and operating cash flow falling to ₹295.2 Cr.

On its 27 July 2026 Q1FY27 call, R R Kabel reported highest-ever quarterly revenue of ₹3,168 Cr (up 54% YoY), EBITDA of ₹285 Cr and PAT of ₹205 Cr, with FMEG reaching operational breakeven and FY28 Wires & Cables margin guidance held at 10.5%.

watchlist.response: Management attributed it mainly to scale and better cost absorption plus product mix, without quantifying each bucket
watchlist.text: Analysts asked for a split of the margin expansion between mix, leverage and one-offs

watchlist.response: Said Q2 is seasonally lower for FMEG and breakeven may not repeat, but yearly breakeven is expected
watchlist.text: Whether FMEG breakeven will sustain every quarter

watchlist.response: Said it was not a normal run rate, driven by dollar movement given export exposure
watchlist.text: Whether the rise in other income was a one-off
